description: This file defines the Drawing class with static methods for converting measurement units (pixels, EMU, points, degrees), handling image creation from BMP files, and related utility functions within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Drawing
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for unit conversions and image handling related to spreadsheet drawings.

methods.name: pixelsToEMU
methods.description: Converts pixel values to EMU units.

methods.name: EMUToPixels
methods.description: Converts EMU units to pixel values.

methods.name: pixelsToCellDimension
methods.description: Converts pixel values to Excel cell dimensions based on font metrics.

methods.name: cellDimensionToPixels
methods.description: Converts Excel cell dimensions to pixel values based on font metrics.

methods.name: angleToDegrees
methods.description: Converts angle units back to degrees.

methods.name: imagecreatefrombmp
methods.description: Creates an image resource from a BMP file, deprecated in favor of PHP's built-in function.
